contract_balance.description: Current contract balance for `token_address` (native via bank, CW20 via the contract's `Balance` query).

max_outstanding.description: Worst-case outstanding: assumes every unclaimed user claims at or after `vesting_end_time` and receives the full APY bonus. The bonus base is the remaining (unclaimed) vesting portion only.

outstanding.description: Σ `amount_eligible` for users who have NOT yet claimed. Pessimistic "still-to-pay if every remaining user claims at vesting end" bound, before the APY bonus. Forfeited mid-vesting portions are excluded — once a user claims, their entire eligibility is settled.

total_claimed.description: Σ amounts actually paid out across all `Claim` calls so far.
